name: phone
advice: Budget: about 40 triangles (560 today, 14.0 times the budget): boxes and 6-sided prisms, detail in the texture; decals (drains, tree pits) as one textured quad on the footway.
One box with the booth painted: 560 triangles today, 240 of them hidden.
Picture: 16-24 sided cylinders, cones and a sphere where a 6-8 sided prism or a flat card reads the same at street distance.
Remove its 240 hidden triangles: faces inside another part or pressed face to face, never seen.
No level of detail: add ~50% levels (meshoptimizer simplify, weld first) and an impostor or nothing past a few pixels.
36 bytes a vertex: quantize (position 3 x int16, normal as 2 x int8 octahedral, colour 4 x uint8): about 12-16 bytes (KHR_mesh_quantization).
